title: Romans Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Romans 7: the law and marriage, the commandment that revealed sin, and the struggle between mind and flesh.

questions.text: For how long does the law have dominion over a man, according to the opening question?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:1 asks whether they do not know that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives.

answers.text: For as long as he lives

questions.text: What happens to a married woman if her husband dies?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:2 says a woman with a husband is bound by law to him while he lives, but if the husband dies she is discharged from the law of the husband.

answers.text: She is still bound by law to her husband
She is discharged from the law of the husband
She must marry her husband's brother
She is called an adulteress by the law

questions.text: Through what were the brothers made dead to the law?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:4 says they were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, so that they would be joined to him who was raised from the dead.

answers.text: Through the preaching of the prophets

questions.text: Which commandment does the writer quote to show how he came to know coveting?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:7 says he would not have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”

questions.text: What does the text say about sin apart from the law?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:8 says that apart from the law, sin is dead.

questions.text: How does the writer describe the law and the commandment?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:12 says the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

questions.text: The law is spiritual, but how does the writer describe himself?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:14 says that we know the law is spiritual, but that he is fleshly, sold under sin.

questions.text: What does the writer say dwells in his flesh?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:18 says that in him, that is, in his flesh, dwells no good thing.

questions.text: What does the writer see in his members, warring against the law of his mind?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:22-23 say he delights in God's law after the inward man, but sees a different law in his members warring against the law of his mind.

questions.text: Whom does the writer thank after crying out about the body of this death?
questions.explanation: Romans 7:24-25 ask who will deliver him out of the body of this death, and he thanks God through Jesus Christ, our Lord.

answers.text: God, through Jesus Christ our Lord
